description: Daten Kommunale Wärmeplanung NRW is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. With these data packages, LANUK provides up-to-date and small-scale technical data to support municipal heating planning. These will be developed as part of the LANUK potential study on the future heat supply in NRW, which is being processed in 2023/2024, and then prepared for the OpenData offer. Coverage: Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. The portal shows the English title as "Data Municipal heating planning NRW" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. Its keywords include Müllverbrennung, Biomasse, Freiflächensolarthermie, Energieatlas NRW, Industrielle Abwärme, Wärmenetze. The listing shows 2024-12-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/dl-zero-de/2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
